items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Jeanette in their responses; the interviewer asks about 'Jeanette' and 'the Jeanette show', but the interviewee responds by discussing other musicians and bands without acknowledging or describing a personal connection to Jeanette.

ctx.x: I didn't make any records with Johnny Detroit. No? No, my brother, I don't think my brother made any of them. Mm-hmm. But he made that, uh, some, I think it was OK records or something like that. Yeah.
Well, you mentioned something about Jeanette. I thought maybe you've gotten to the Jeanette show. I, I, I, uh. Start the Anaconda.

Oh, we made a, excuse me, we made a, when we, when, when, when we left Chicago with the four men, that the first time we went, we left, after, after Spanish Ford, we had Bill Krieger, Charlie Hartman, Johnny Bieselman, myself, see. Dave Lewin and we got on piano, you should call it. Mm-hmm. I was trying to think of the guy's name, Dave Lewin. Mm-hmm. He had a band that, uh, one of those big hotels, uh, you know. Like the Pump Room or something like that. That's the way it worked. Well, anyway, he, uh, he, at that…
